name: Battlecry
text: Triggers when the card is played from hand.

name: Deathrattle
text: Triggers when the card is destroyed.

name: Taunt
text: The opponent cannot attack friendly characters without Taunt.

name: Rush
text: Can attack enemy minions the turn it is summoned.

name: Discover
text: Choose one of three random cards.

name: Secret
text: Spell placed face-down that triggers on a condition, hidden from the opponent.

name: Lifesteal
text: Damage dealt also heals your hero.

name: Divine Shield
text: Absorbs the first damage, then is removed.

name: Stealth
text: Cannot be targeted by the enemy until it attacks or deals damage.

name: Combo
text: Bonus if another card was played this turn.

name: Choose One
text: Choose between two or more effects.

name: Overload
text: Locks that many mana crystals on your next turn.

name: Freeze
text: A frozen character misses its next attack.

name: Spell Damage
text: Your spells deal extra damage.

name: Charge
text: Can attack the turn it is summoned.

name: Dormant
text: Becomes a permanent that cannot act or be interacted with until a condition is met.

name: Poisonous
text: Destroys any minion it damages.

name: Reborn
text: The first time it dies, returns with 1 Health.

name: Corpse
text: Death Knight resource gained when friendly minions die, spent with mana on some cards.

name: Tradeable
text: Can be shuffled back into the deck for 1 mana to draw a new card.

name: Immune
text: Prevents all damage and enemy interaction.

name: Windfury
text: Can attack twice each turn.

name: Elusive
text: Cannot be targeted by spells or Hero Powers.

name: Outcast
text: Bonus if it is the left- or right-most card in hand.

name: Silence
text: Removes all card text, enchantments and abilities from a minion.

name: Temporary
text: Discarded at the end of your turn.

name: Infuse
text: Gains an effect after enough friendly minions die while it is in hand.

name: Quest
text: Placed on the battlefield with a requirement; completing it grants a Reward.

name: Sidequest
text: A smaller Quest that does not start in the mulligan.

name: Questline
text: A Quest in three steps, each with its own reward.

name: Jade Golem
text: Summoned golems grow +1/+1 each time one is summoned.

name: Corrupt
text: Gains an effect if you play a more expensive card while it is in hand.

name: Magnetic
text: Played next to a Mech, merges into it, combining stats and effects.

name: Kindred
text: Bonus if a card of the same type or school was played last turn.

name: Colossal
text: Comes with extra body-part minions.

name: Rewind
text: After a random effect, can be rewound for a different outcome.

name: Finale
text: Bonus if you have no unspent mana when it is played.

name: Spellburst
text: One-time effect the first time you cast a spell.

name: Honorable Kill
text: Triggers when dealing exactly lethal damage.

name: Forge
text: In hand, pay 2 mana to permanently upgrade the card.

name: Dredge
text: Look at the bottom three cards of the deck and put one on top.

name: Inspire
text: Triggers each time you use your Hero Power.

name: Start of Game
text: Triggers at the start of the game.

name: Starship
text: Pieces that die are stored into a starship that can later be launched.

name: Miniaturize
text: Also gives a 1-mana 1/1 copy of itself when played.

name: Prepare
text: In hand, drag to the deck to spend all remaining mana and reduce the card cost by that much plus one; cannot be played the same turn.

name: Dark Gift
text: A random bonus effect on a discovered minion.

name: Frenzy
text: One-time effect the first time it survives damage.

name: Echo
text: Can be replayed any number of times in the turn it is played.

name: Herald
text: Summons a soldier and upgrades your Colossal.

name: Excavate
text: Gives a treasure card that gets better each time you Excavate.

name: Imbue
text: Replaces and further empowers your Hero Power each time.

name: Lackey
text: 1-mana 1/1 minions with Battlecries.

name: Adapt
text: Choose one of three upgrades.

name: Quickdraw
text: Bonus if played the turn it entered your hand.

name: Overkill
text: Triggers when dealing more damage than needed to kill.

name: Invoke
text: Triggers your Galakrond hero power and upgrades Galakrond.

name: Titan
text: Instead of attacking, uses one of three abilities once each; attacks once all are used.

name: Twinspell
text: Casting it gives another copy without Twinspell.

name: Bonus Effect
text: Gains a random keyword (Taunt, Windfury, Divine Shield, Poisonous, Elusive, Rush, Lifesteal or Reborn).

name: Manathirst
text: Bonus if you have enough mana crystals.

name: Recruit
text: Summons a random minion from your deck.

name: Overheal
text: Triggers when healed above maximum Health.

name: Fabled
text: While deckbuilding, adding it also adds synergistic uncollectible cards to the deck.

name: Shatter
text: When drawn, splits into two halves at both ends of the hand, each with half the effect; they recombine if they meet.

name: Counter
text: Prevents a played card from taking effect.

name: Enrage
text: While damaged, gains an effect.

name: Gigantify
text: Also gives an 8-mana 8/8 copy of itself when played.

name: Mega-Windfury
text: Can attack four times each turn.

name: Cast When Drawn
text: Automatically cast for free when drawn.

name: Spare Part
text: 1-mana spells with minor benefits.

name: Reward
text: Card granted for completing a Quest.
